title: helianthemum canum var. alpinum
intro: Helianthemum canum var. alpinum, commonly known as Alpine Rockrose or Snow Rose, is a flowering plant species that belongs to the family Cistaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, including its potential health benefits such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities. The therapeutic actions of Helianthemum canum var. alpinum include its use in traditional medicine to treat various conditions like wounds, skin issues, and respiratory problems, as well as its potential as an anti-anxiety and anti-depressant agent. The plant's bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
